author: izjust4fun
body:
Hey guys here is mine and Crazy_Clownz's newest map, Tarteros!

It's a 4 team CTH map based in a jungle paradise. You basically spawn and leap off of your team's ledge and get right into the fight!

We hope you like it :D 

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/xx7r71zuqj8nvjx/Tarteros.zip 
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/5jGhS
YML: http://pastebin.com/vaSmm4n3 (No fall damage, and players are awarded one golden apple per kill)
